builds.title: Steady Furniture
builds.note: Fixed desks, plants and watercoolers flickering and jumping around while you walk.

builds.title: A Full Life
builds.note: 1 real minute = 1 year. A full run from 40 to 100 takes about an hour (Save & Exit keeps your place).

builds.title: Swarms
builds.note: Enemies now arrive in packs that grow each decade (1 at 40, up to 6 in your 90s), and the spawn rate ramps smoothly every year.

builds.title: Fight Back
builds.note: Bills take 2 hits. Enemies spawn about 25-40% faster at every age, and packs grow sooner.

builds.title: New Faces
builds.note: 3 AM Thought (age 50+): fades into a ghost you can't hit, then turns solid again.

builds.title: Arsenal
builds.note: The TV Remote: a boomerang thrown at the nearest enemy that hits both ways.

builds.title: High Scores
builds.note: Every run ends with a score: years survived, enemies beaten and 401(k) coins earned.

builds.title: Online Board
builds.note: Scores now post to one shared online leaderboard for everyone who plays.

builds.title: Playtest Fixes
builds.note: Phones: steering works again after Retry. Perks need a second tap to confirm, so no more accidental picks.

builds.title: Midlife Mode
